summary:
Round 17 scan: the post-R8 operating plan for 27 Sep 12:00Z to 30 Sep.

Honest answer: NOTHING REACHES R8. No mechanism can pass a lab gate, a dummy and a new user OK before 12:00Z, and every IDEAS family is closed, frozen or post-deadline.

New facts:
- E10 P1 at 11:01Z is NOT met: 0 kernel changes; >= 0.955 = 254; we are #260, 6th of 115 in the 0.954 block.
- The 11:01:09Z poll header still shows 43/44 PENDING; expected terminal ~12:20-13:00Z.

Deliverables:
- F3: a dated master schedule. It runs from the 12:00Z lapse line and the 43/44 read, through the RESUME POINT (by ~15:00Z), E10 P1 at hh:04 every 3 h (last 29 Sep 00:04Z) and the last port submit (02:00Z). Then the tick checks (28 Sep 17:57Z; 29 Sep 11:57Z / 17:57Z), a 19:00Z L9 read, a 20:05Z FINALS FROZEN read, the 23:27Z snapshot, and the private read from 30 Sep 00:15Z.
- F4: the 43/44 outcome tree and a re-tick matrix by ref.
- F5: slot plan. Slots are insurance for an E10 port only; expected use ~0.
- F6: E10 port runbook with time arithmetic; worth ~+0.001-0.006 P(bronze).
- F7: tick-check card.
- F8: the open user decisions with deadlines and defaults. The default needs no user action.

Two new ops items:
- F9: a timer and poller restore card, because every timer is session-only.
- F10: a pre-registered tools/private_read.py, pushed with the I-336 hindsight guard before 29 Sep 23:00Z.

F11: the public board is not final at the 23:27Z snapshot, so the public LB is also saved hourly on 30 Sep.

Every score gain is 0 except the E10 watch. Calibration-only submits in spare slots were considered and rejected (FREEZE, low information).

findings.what:
E10 v1 WATCH + PORT RUNBOOK with time arithmetic.
Cadence: timer 2e87e414 at hh:04 every 3 h, acting to 29 Sep 00:30 -> 13 checks, the last at 29 Sep 00:04Z.
On a P2 signal:
1. Chrome connected? If not, notify and wait (P4c (7)).
2. Page score >= 0.956 on version k == M.
3. pull -m; P4b(a) metadata; sources listable; kernel_sources == [].
4. tools/e10_port_gate.py static (--version M): rc 0.
5. Pause other API agents; push the private dummy (~33 min incl. queue).
6. Full gate: rc 0 AND 0 [FAIL]/[SKIP] AND one 'author version: M' line. On 429: 60 s backoff for up to 20 min.
7. W6: header < 15 min and not a 429. Submit guard: no 'dryrun', no NEVER_SUBMIT.md. Send a PushNotification.
8. P6 read (COMPLETE, L_hi <= 7.5 h, display >= 0.956) -> the user re-ticks {PORT, INS}. This holds for a no-insertion port only; otherwise ask.
Time: trigger-to-submit-ready is 45-60 min, so a 00:04Z trigger submits ~01:05Z (< 02:00Z). With +7.5 h it scores ~08:35-09:30Z, well before the 19:00Z read.
Value: P(v1 trigger by 29 Sep 00:00) ~1-3%. The v2 prior was 5-15% for >= 0.954; nothing new has appeared in 6 days; the x138 author's team shows 0.956 but his notebook is still v1. Given an adopted port: +0.1 to +0.2 P(bronze). Net ~+0.001-0.006 P(bronze).
Cost: 8 CLI calls per P1. On a trigger: 1 slot + the author's <= 7.5 h hidden run.
